source_caption_text:
Don Toliver has a message for everyone waiting on his next album: “When I drop this new album… JUST WATCH” 👀🔥

Don made the statement before previewing new music for fans on the European leg of his Octane World Tour, giving the crowd a taste of what he’s been working on.

He’s clearly confident about what’s coming, and these live previews are adding to the anticipation. Fans attending the tour are getting to hear the unreleased material through the venue speakers before it officially drops 🏁

How’s the new music sounding? Y’all ready for Don’s next album? 🔥
